note: All 30 original NPS A.T. Treadway features (June 2023 version, GPS surveys from 1998–2022 plus supplemental information) are drawn over eastern-US relief. Separate club sections, source bends and gaps are retained. The bright line is a widened map symbol rasterized onto the terrain, not the width of the footpath. Relief is exaggerated 8×; horizontal coordinates and Earth curvature retain geographic scale. The regional aperture supplies context and its edges do not measure trail length. The 3,536.4 km catalog quantity is accumulated walking distance, not map extent; the source is not claimed to be the 2024 alignment. This is not a navigation or property-access map. No crop walls, underside, stand, independent ruler or schematic geometry is included.
